The warehouse stock list now leaves out products whose quantity is 0, so WH-1 in your example shows only "Bolt 10". I changed one line: `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` now filters on `s.quantity > 0`, as the other stock overviews already do.

The separate single-product quantity lookup uses a different query, so asking for the nuts in WH-1 should still answer 0. I didn't test that case specifically, and I didn't add a test for the new filter. The full offline test suite passes.
